paras: The Cap-Haitien least gecko (Sphaerodactylus lazelli) is a species of lizard in the family Sphaerodactylidae. The species is endemic to Haiti.
The specific name, lazelli, is in honor of American herpetologist James Draper "Skip" Lazell, Jr. (born 1939).
The preferred habitat of S. lazelli is forest at sea level.
The holotype of S. lazelli has a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 31 mm (1.2 in).
